messages:
morgan: Rolling update to release-train policy: short release freeze window for the Friday ship and stricter canary gating for model swaps. TL;DR below.

ci-bot: Weekly changelog draft: - Freeze window shortened to 2h for Friday ships - Canary mandatory for model/infra changes affecting >3% traffic - New `/deploy-exempt` quick path for low-risk config changes

nina (eng): Question: >3% traffic threshold seems tight for infra patches. Is that per-endpoint or global?

morgan: It's per-endpoint. We want more coverage on smaller services where a change can have outsized impact. For infra-wide changes we default to staged rollouts.

rafa (sre): Canary gates updated: 5m smoke -> 25% for 20m -> 60% for 10m -> full. Auto-rollback on error spike or tail-latency regression. We'll publish dashboards and a simple runbook.

drew (release-manager): Exemption flow: `/deploy-exempt --service <svc> --env prod --reason "<short>" --owner @<you> --tags <tag1>` routes to oncall+release-manager and should be acknowledged within 25m. Use only for config toggles, DNS, or small routing flags. No artifact swaps.

tara (product): For model quantization rollouts for embeddings: do we need a canary if traffic <3% but cost delta >10%?

morgan: Yes — cost/longevity impacts count. If expected cost delta >10% or latency change >15ms, treat as a canary scenario and open an eval snapshot in the PR.

rafa (sre): During the freeze we'll enable higher-fidelity traces for inference endpoints and increase log retention to 72h for team review. Also: synthetic probes every 3m.

ci-bot: Policy record appended: release-train-policy v3.0. Audit ref: https://redwood.internal/audit/rt-policy-3.0

nina (eng): ack'd. I'll prep the canary manifest for the quantized embed model.

morgan: Thanks all. Adding a short blurb to the weekly release broadcast: "Release train: updated canary gates, shorter Friday freeze, exemption CLI for low-risk config changes, enhanced canary alerts." Ping here with any blockers.
file_description: short engineering release train broadcast about freeze window change, canary gating, exemption flow, and weekly changelog entry
